name: openbb_unemployment
description:
Unemployment rate for a country from the OECD through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.unemployment).
Returns: {country, data: [records with date, country and value (percent)]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): country (lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, france; default united_states); provider (oecd only in OpenBB 4.6; default oecd, no key).
US-only alternatives: av_unemployment, fred_unemployment. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"country": "france"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores (e.g. united_states)
